title: Sheaf presentation by a covering set of sheafified representables
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $E\subseteq\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal D)$ be a set such that every object of $\mathcal D$ has a covering by objects of $E$. For $V\in E$ put $h_V(W)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(W,V)$, with restriction by precomposition, and let $h_V^\#$ be its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Every sheaf of sets $H$ on $\mathcal D$ admits a coequalizer diagram $P_1\rightrightarrows P_0\to H$ in $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$, where $P_i=\coprod_{j\in J_i}h_{V_{i,j}}^\#$ for sets $J_i$ and objects $V_{i,j}\in E$, for $i=0,1$. Coproducts and coequalizers are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; the coequalizer assertion means that, for every sheaf $K$, composition induces a bijection from $\operatorname{Hom}(H,K)$ to the set of maps $P_0\to K$ whose composites with the two maps $P_1\to P_0$ agree.

proof.text: The sheafification adjunction (Mathlib sheafificationAdjunction) and the universe-raised Yoneda equivalence (uliftYonedaEquiv) identify maps from the sheafified representable of V to a sheaf T with sections of T(V), naturally in T. This uses only the universal property of sheafification, without computing the plus construction and without subcanonicity.

source.place: Tag 00WS, lemma-sheaf-coequalizer-representable, first paragraph; equation-map-representable-into-sheaf preceding Tag 00WR, using Theorem 00WB and Proposition 00WH

proof.text: For any sheaf T, let I(T) be the sigma type of V in E and t in T(V). Take the coproduct P(T) of the sheafified representables indexed by I(T), using Mathlib Sheaf colimits and coproductIsCoproduct. Sheaf colimits are obtained by sheafifying presheaf colimits, so their universal property is the one obtained from the sheafification adjunction. The maps from step 1 define q_T by Sigma.desc; Sigma.ι_desc identifies its restriction to each summand with the map corresponding to t. The index type lies in Type(max u w). This construction also allows an empty index type.

source.place: Tag 00WS, first paragraph, displayed coproduct; Tag 00WI, lemma-colimit-sheaves, universal property specialized to coproducts

proof.text: Prove q_T epi by cancellation. If f,g:T→K agree after q_T, precomposing with every coproduct injection and applying the natural sheafification and Yoneda bijections gives f_V(t)=g_V(t) for every V in E and t in T(V). For any U and t in T(U), choose the covering R supplied by the covering hypothesis. Naturality identifies the restrictions of f_U(t) and g_U(t) along R.f(i) with their equal values on T(R.f(i))(t), because R.X(i) lies in E. Separatedness of K for the covering presieve R.presieve₀ implies f_U(t)=g_U(t), even if the covering is empty. Thus f=g and q_T is epi. In Lean this uses isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type, isSheafFor_of_mem_precoverage and isSeparatedFor.ext; it does not use the local-surjectivity criterion.

source.place: Tag 00WS, first paragraph, epimorphism assertion; Tag 00WN, lemma-mono-epi-sheaves

proof.text: Apply the proved epimorphic presentation to H, giving P₀ and q. Use the sheaf pullback K=pullback q q with its two projections r,s; Mathlib Sites.Limits supplies this limit. Apply the same presentation to K, giving P₁ and an epimorphism e:P₁→K. Set d₀=e≫r and d₁=e≫s. Associativity and pullback.condition prove d₀≫q=d₁≫q.

source.place: Tag 00WS, second paragraph, construction of the fibre product and its presentation; Tag 00W2, lemma-limit-sheaf

proof.text: Sheaves of sets form a regular epi category (Mathlib Sites.RegularEpi), so the epi q is regular by IsRegularEpiCategory.regularEpiOfEpi. Its canonical kernel pair is IsKernelPair.of_hasPullback q. Apply its toCoequalizer' to obtain the coequalizer universal property for q and r,s.

source.place: Tag 086K, lemma-coequalizer-surjection, invoked at the end of Tag 00WS

proof.text: For a cofork t of d₀,d₁, cancel the epi e in its cofork equation to get r≫t.π=s≫t.π. Descend t.π through the kernel-pair coequalizer. Its factorization equation follows from Cofork.IsColimit.π_desc; uniqueness follows from Cofork.IsColimit.hom_ext for that coequalizer. Cofork.IsColimit.mk combines these into an actual colimit witness with vertex H. Package the two coproduct colimit witnesses and this coequalizer witness into the required existential.

source.place: Tag 00WS, final sentence, with the universal property of Tag 086K written out after precomposing the kernel pair by an epimorphism
